testcase.name: Scenario: Hide and show a solid body from the browser: tmp/obk-body-visibility-Gi8hyJ/source/features/application/model-browser/model-browser.feature:186:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Hide and show a solid body from the browser ✔ Given an active part in the MCAD Software contains one visible solid block ✔ And the solid body row is visible in the model browser ✔ When the user right-clicks the solid body row ✔ Then the block faces are highlighted in blue ✔ And Visibility is checked in the context menu ✔ When the user chooses Visibility ✔ Then the block disappears from the viewport ✔ And the body and its feature remain represented in the browser ✔ When the user right-clicks the hidden body row ✔ Then Visibility is not checked ✔ And the hidden body is indicated by a blue wireframe while selected ✔ When the user chooses Visibility again ✔ Then the shaded block returns in the same apparent view
